valid_alternatives.window: WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, SUM(units) OVER(PARTITION BY tenant,queue ORDER BY priority DESC,request_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS used_units FROM requests WHERE status='active') SELECT tenant,queue,request_id,used_units FROM ranked WHERE used_units<=capacity ORDER BY tenant,queue,priority DESC,request_id
valid_alternatives.correlated: SELECT r.tenant,r.queue,r.request_id,(SELECT SUM(p.units) FROM requests p WHERE p.status='active' AND p.tenant=r.tenant AND p.queue=r.queue AND (p.priority>r.priority OR p.priority=r.priority AND p.request_id<=r.request_id)) AS used_units FROM requests r WHERE r.status='active' AND used_units<=r.capacity ORDER BY r.tenant,r.queue,r.priority DESC,r.request_id
